description: Schienennetze Norddeutschland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Verkehr und Mobilitätswende (BVM). Web Feature Service (WFS) with all relevant rail networks in northern Germany, differentiated according to the type (long-distance railway electrified, long-distance railway not electrified, metro, suburban railway, tram/tram, narrow-gauge railway, out of service). For a more detailed description of the data and data responsibility, please use the reference to the data set description. Coverage: Behörde für Verkehr und Mobilitätswende (BVM). The portal shows the English title as "WFS Rail Networks Northern Germany" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Verkehr und Mobilitätswende (BVM). Its keywords include OSM, Schiene, Bahn, Netzwerk, OpenStreetMap. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
